page.notes: The first word of the line "favouré" is uncertain: the initial letter may be "s" or "f" (savouré or favouré); marked [?]. "vre" at the start of line 5 is the end of "recouvre" printed over a line break, left as printed. "estre" at line 5 end and "[?]duisable" at line 6 start: the initial letter of "duisable" is partly hidden by a mark in the margin; marked [?] on "estre" line end is not needed, so only "duisable" is doubtful. The printed spelling "Pentateuqves" and "dechifrer" are kept as printed except u/v adjusted. Printing error "Pentateuqves" for Pentateuques is left in the spelling of the printer's form; check. Small marks in the left margin (lines 6, 17, 22) are dust or ink specks, not reference marks. The digitiser watermark at the bottom right is excluded.
